_comment: Per-tenant (employer_domain) first successful pull date — the day this pipeline onboarded the tenant. Records whose first_seen is on/before this date are onboarding BACKFILL and never count as 'new' (see normalize/model.py effective_new_date). Keyed on employer_domain, NOT source_id: tenants sharing a platform onboarded on different days. Set ONCE at onboarding and never updated (append a line in the add-tenant SOP). Seeded 2026-09-16 from min(first_seen) per employer_domain. A tenant missing from this map falls back to min(first_seen), which drifts as its earliest backfill retires — prefer keeping this explicit. 2026-09-18 pass: (1) pinned the 15 tenants that were still on the fallback (Paradox/appcast/avature/ultipro/phenom-aviation wave, all first-pulled 09-17 except wfs.aero 09-16) to their observed min(first_seen), verified against seen_state + run_log (offset from Notion's 09-16 onboard = the first recurring --all pull ran 09-17, not a reset). (2) corrected cintas/uhaul/sysco/gensco/sherwin, whose seeded values sat ONE DAY LATER than the observed first-pull stamp and were over-suppressing genuine day-after-onboarding arrivals as backfill, down to the observed min.
